facts.fact: The ICT4D Policy Statement 2018-2028, a final report commissioned by the Ministry of Information and Communication Infrastructure, states on its title page that it was validated in December 2016 and revised in December 2017; the passages held show no adopting act, and its eight pillars span the state (electronic government) and the economy (private sector, agriculture, education, social services, broadband and legal regime).
facts.system: The Gambia ICT for Development (ICT4D) Policy Statement [2018-2028]

facts.fact: The ICT4D Policy Statement carries the stated period 2018-2028 in its title and is published as a full text on the government policies portal (policies.gov.gm); its date is the December 2017 revision, so the as-at test against the period is the parent's.
